name: improve_bench_ideas
description: A collection of community-contributed suggestions and proposals aimed at improving benchmarks used with retrieval-augmented generation for mathematical problems. The dataset catalogs qualitative ideas (e.g., new tasks, evaluation protocols, or dataset designs) rather than standardized machine-evaluated examples. It is intended to support researchers and practitioners planning benchmark or evaluation improvements.
reputation: Niche, community-contributed dataset hosted on Hugging Face primarily used for brainstorming and design, not widespread standardized evaluation.
